root_cause_label: Agent launches QEMU with interactive Windows XP installer but has no mechanism to automate the installation (no unattended answer file, no VNC input), so the VM can never reach the login screen without human intervention.
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent launched QEMU with the Windows XP ISO assuming the installation would complete automatically, but the interactive installer requires VNC-driven human input that was never provided, so the VM never reached the login screen.
t_err_evidence: qemu-system-i386 ... -boot d launched without explicit raw format or any unattended product-key/tb-admin install configuration.
t_commit_evidence: Step 4 commits to an interactive QEMU launch without any automation path; from this point the Windows XP installer is waiting for human VNC input and no subsequent action by the agent can navigate it, locking in the failure.
t_surface_evidence: WARNING: Image format was not specified for '/app/isos/xp.img' ... write operations on block 0 will be restricted.
trigger_explanation: The agent acted on the false premise that launching QEMU with the Windows XP ISO and a raw disk image would result in an automated installation reaching the login screen, when in reality the installer is interactive and requires VNC-driven user input for disk setup, license acceptance, product key entry, and administrator account naming.
